The department of Pharmacy AWKUM was established on the 6th of November 2013 and recognized by the Pharmacy Council of Pakistan on the 18th of August 2018, it is one of the most highly-rated pharmacy departments in Pakistan. As the newly growing department in the field of Pharmaceutical Sciences, throughout which it has retained its identity as a specialist institution/department dedicated to teaching and research in pharmacy. The University was ranked no 1 in 2021 and is currently rated 2nd in Pakistan. The department of Pharmacy has local/international collaboration effectively with others to support the discovery, development, and rational use of medications for the welfare and safety of the public.
Mission:

The Department of Pharmacy is committed to provide:
Basic education and training of students to ensure the rational use of medications.
Mentoring and training of staff members to enhance their professional competency.
Educating patients and healthcare professionals on the safe use of medications.
Providing health education programs to the community to prevent disease and promote public health.
Making sound decisions supported by evidence-based medicine through research on medication use and patient safety.
Utilizing research methods to identify the most cost-effective use of medications.
Initiating and supporting interdisciplinary collaborative research.
PROGRAM OFFERED
5 Years Pharm-D (Doctor of Pharmacy)
Mphil (Pharmaceutical Sciences)
PhD (Pharmaceutical Sciences)
LABORATORIES
The department has modern laboratories outfitted with sophisticated equipments and other facilities to carry out the necessary lab work in:
Basic Medical Sciences
Pharmaceutical Chemistry
Pharmaceutics
Pharmacognosy
Pharmaceutical Microbiology
Industrial Pharmacy
Instrumentation/ Pharmaceutical Analysis
Computer Lab
